svg.title: Celestial card back — curved white crescents
svg.desc: Two-way rotationally symmetric navy, dusty peach, and cream card back. Rounded white crescents sit inside double rings with a clear gap. Each end pairs two stars with a centered five-point constellation, mirrored by a half-turn. A filled peach north star with a cream center sits within the central orbit rings and radial rays. Star accents adapted from Phosphor Icons and the central north star adapted from Tabler Icons, under their MIT licenses.
